title: QLD - Upgrade the Network
current_summary: Planned network upgrades in Queensland scheduled for 5 October have been cancelled by our upstream provider. No service interruptions are expected to occur during this window.

updates.content:
We will be supporting planned works by our network partner in Queensland to update access network equipment.

- Window: 11:00 PM on 5 October to 5:00 AM on 6 October (QLD time)
- Expected impact: A brief loss of internet connectivity for affected services, with a planned interruption of up to 15 minutes around 12:00 AM
- What we’re doing: We’ll monitor progress and confirm when services are back to normal

If your service does not reconnect after 5:00 AM, please restart your modem/router. If issues persist, contact our support team. Thank you for your patience while this work is completed.
The planned network maintenance scheduled for Queensland on 5 October has been cancelled by our upstream provider. There will be no service interruptions during this time.
